_note: social-domain-procedures-are-case-types (coordinator 23 Oct): a procedure that held a BSN or a sensitive test on its own record, readable only by dossiq-sensitive, keeps exactly that access as a case. `subjectBsn` is the BSN of the person the case is about; `sensitiveProperties` holds the answers to the case type's fields flagged `sensitive`, in the same shape as `properties`. Both carry the property authorization OpenRegister enforces (`authorization`, not `x-openregister-authorization`, which Schema::propertyCarriesAuthorization does not read). propertyDefinition gains `sensitive`. case 1.49.0, propertyDefinition 1.7.0. The case form routes a sensitive definition's answer to sensitiveProperties through `values.arrayKeyBy` (nextcloud-vue).

subjectBsn.title: Subject BSN
subjectBsn.description: The citizen service number of the person this case is about. Readable and writable only by the group dossiq-sensitive; the cross-domain lookup asks for it as the system and answers only whether an open case exists, in which domain and whom to call.

sensitiveProperties.title: Sensitive properties
sensitiveProperties.description: The answers to the case type's fields flagged sensitive, in the shape of `properties`. Readable and writable only by the group dossiq-sensitive.

name.title: Name
name.description: The definition's name, stored beside the value

value.title: Value
value.description: The answer, as text. A non-scalar answer is stored JSON-encoded

sensitive.title: Sensitive
sensitive.description: Whether an answer to this field is sensitive personal data, such as an income or asset test. A sensitive answer is kept in the case's sensitiveProperties, which only the group dossiq-sensitive reads.
